About this item

  • PREMIUM AEROLIGHT TECHNOLOGY: Experience next-level hydration with the Stanley IceFlow Flip Straw 2.0 Bottle, featuring AeroLight spun-steel insulation that makes it 33% lighter than standard stainless-steel bottles. This featherweight design ensures easy portability without compromising on cooling performance, keeping your water refreshingly cold for hours, perfect for staying hydrated during your daily activities or intense workouts.
  • ENHANCED HYDRATION: The Flip Straw 2.0 lid of this bottle is designed for convenience and speed. It comes with a larger drink opening and a built-in straw, allowing you to hydrate faster and easier. Simply flip to sip, snap it shut securely, and slip the bottle into your bag or car cupholder for on-the-go hydration.
  • LEAK-RESISTANT LID: The Flip Straw 2.0 lid is engineered to be leak-resistant, ensuring that your beverages stay securely contained without accidental spills. The replaceable seal adds to the longevity of the bottle, allowing you to enjoy leak-free performance for extended periods. This thoughtful design feature enhances the overall usability and reliability of the bottle.
  • DISHWASHER SAFE: Designed with user convenience in mind, the IceFlow Flip Straw 2.0 Bottle is dishwasher safe for effortless cleaning. Additionally, the new spout is removable, making it easier to clean for hygienic use every time. It’s the ideal companion for your active lifestyle, whether you're at the gym, on the trail, or commuting to work.
  • BUILT FOR LIFE: Since 1913 we've promised to provide rugged, capable gear for food and drink, built to last a lifetime. It's a promise we still keep.

Product Description

Next level hydration. The IceFlow Flip Straw 2.0 Bottle has premium AeroLight technology that makes it 33% lighter than standard stainless-steel bottles. Featherweight spun-steel insulation keeps your water ice-cold for hours. The folding handle attached to your flip straw water bottle makes this the perfect grab and go for a hot yoga class. The Flip Straw 2.0 lid has a larger drink opening and a built-in straw, so you can hydrate faster. Flip to sip, snap it shut and slip the water bottle into your bag. You can even pop off the new spout for a deeper clean.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    I’ve been using this Stanley IceFlow bottle every day, and I really like it. The 24 oz size holds enough water without making the bottle too large or heavy. The flip straw works smoothly and makes it easy to drink while driving, working, or exercising. When the straw is completely closed, the bottle does not leak in my bag. It also keeps my water cold for several hours.

    The handle is comfortable to carry, the bottle fits well in my car’s cup holder, and the Sorbet Garden color is beautiful in person. It is also easy to take apart and clean. This is a great option for anyone looking for a practical, durable water bottle for daily use. I would definitely recommend it.

    I love my new Stanley IceFlow Aerolight 50 oz bottle. It’s really beautiful and love the lilac colour. The straw hole is wider and comfortable to drink from. It doesn’t leak and is definitely much lighter than my Yeti 46 oz. However, I gave it 4 stars because it doesn’t keep ice and water as long as my Yeti. The ice lasts up to 8 or 9 hours then melts, but the water remains cool a while longer. My Yeti 46 oz can keep ice up to one and a half days. I guess to make it lighter the insulation is not as thick so it doesn’t maintain coldness as long as the double insulated Yetis. Update: April 1. I had to come back and write an additional update. The longer I have this bottle is the more I love it. It is keeping the ice and water longer now. Not sure why it wasn't when I just got it. It is beautiful holds a lot and I absolutely love it even more than my Yeti which I had really loved. It is so tall and slender and just beautiful. Thank you Stanley & Amazon!

    This is the perfect on the go size STANLEY. The color is cute. I LOVE to take water with me, but I don’t always want to take a HUGE tumbler. This water bottle holds two cups of water. I love the fact that the straw isn’t exposed and folds down easily w/o spilling. Although this is a smaller sized tumbler it still has great insulation. I would recommend this for tweens and children that want a STANLEY cup but may not responsible enough for the STANLEY price. This is also good for a busy mom on the go that realizes a 40 oz. tumbler may be impractical to take when running errands. This cup is a great lightweight way to get hydration on the go. The cup doesn’t have an aftertaste and it doesn’t hold in the taste of beverages after you’ve washed the cup so your water will always taste like water, even if you’ve previously have filled the cup with iced coffee or tea.

    4 out of 5 stars
    Falls short to Yeti but still nice!
    Reviewed in the United States on July 29, 2025
    Color: BlackSize: 50 Ounces
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I wanted this Stanley to be my reason to turn away from Yeti. I love the modern design, the all black, the non-fixed handle that can be tightened to be more fixed/harder to move, and the 50 oz capacity. It was nice to see that the bottle had 4 extra oz of capacity at the same price as Yeti’s 46 oz bottle. I need to drink lots of water throughout the day and the large capacity is awesome. The lightness was originally a selling point for me; while it can hold an astonishingly large 50 oz, since the bottle is relatively light in weight, it doesn’t feel too heavy to carry a full bottle around. However, where it excels in lightness it falls short in quality. It is glaringly lower quality than Yeti’s 46 oz bottle. This Stanley has thinner metal leading to poorer insulation. What frustrated me the most was realizing how much thinner the coating was compared to Yeti; I accidentally dinged it with a fork while heating up my lunch and chipped it! I’ve dropped my Yetis dozens of times and hit them with everything from forks and knives to granite countertops and haven’t had an issue with them chipping under light use. I even noticed it will take on light scratches from the plastic buckles on my lunch box if I let them touch while in my bag. Seriously poor coating. However, getting back to the pros, the leak resistance is great and when properly closed you can rest assured you won’t have spillage or leakage. Also the straw on this bottle is much nicer than the straws on Yeti bottles; less resistance and simply easier to sip. In the end, it’s a great water bottle that has a cool modern look and a huge capacity. Overall this comes in at 4/5 stars with only one star being lost to the thinner metal and thinner coating. I would still suggest getting the Yeti 46 oz instead for the thicker metal and coating as it will likely last longer and endure more.

Product Summary: STANLEY IceFlow Flip Straw 2.0 Bottle, 24 oz, Sorbet Garden | Easy Carry Handle | Twist On Lid and Flip Up Straw | Lightweight Water Bottle | Insulated Stainless Steel | BPA-Free

About this Item

  • PREMIUM AEROLIGHT TECHNOLOGY: Experience next-level hydration with the Stanley IceFlow Flip Straw 2.0 Bottle, featuring AeroLight spun-steel insulation that makes it 33% lighter than standard stainless-steel bottles. This featherweight design ensures easy portability without compromising on cooling performance, keeping your water refreshingly cold for hours, perfect for staying hydrated during your daily activities or intense workouts.
  • ENHANCED HYDRATION: The Flip Straw 2.0 lid of this bottle is designed for convenience and speed. It comes with a larger drink opening and a built-in straw, allowing you to hydrate faster and easier. Simply flip to sip, snap it shut securely, and slip the bottle into your bag or car cupholder for on-the-go hydration.
  • LEAK-RESISTANT LID: The Flip Straw 2.0 lid is engineered to be leak-resistant, ensuring that your beverages stay securely contained without accidental spills. The replaceable seal adds to the longevity of the bottle, allowing you to enjoy leak-free performance for extended periods. This thoughtful design feature enhances the overall usability and reliability of the bottle.
  • DISHWASHER SAFE: Designed with user convenience in mind, the IceFlow Flip Straw 2.0 Bottle is dishwasher safe for effortless cleaning. Additionally, the new spout is removable, making it easier to clean for hygienic use every time. It’s the ideal companion for your active lifestyle, whether you're at the gym, on the trail, or commuting to work.
  • BUILT FOR LIFE: Since 1913 we've promised to provide rugged, capable gear for food and drink, built to last a lifetime. It's a promise we still keep.

Product Description

Next level hydration. The IceFlow Flip Straw 2.0 Bottle has premium AeroLight technology that makes it 33% lighter than standard stainless-steel bottles. Featherweight spun-steel insulation keeps your water ice-cold for hours. The folding handle attached to your flip straw water bottle makes this the perfect grab and go for a hot yoga class. The Flip Straw 2.0 lid has a larger drink opening and a built-in straw, so you can hydrate faster. Flip to sip, snap it shut and slip the water bottle into your bag. You can even pop off the new spout for a deeper clean.
